title: Changing Their Tune: How Consumers' Adoption of Online Streaming Affects Music Consumption and Discovery
eligible_reason: Binary absorbing treatment (adoption of Spotify) switching on at user-specific weeks (66 distinct adoption weeks among 1,855 adopters in spotify_users.csv), matched never-adopter controls, user fixed effects (areg, abs(user_id)) and week fixed effects (_Iperiod*), no controls, clustered by user. The main tables use three post-adoption relative-time bins (0-1, 2-24, 25+ weeks since adoption; all pre-adoption weeks as reference), i.e. a binned unstacked event study; Appendix E also reports a one-dummy static version ('1treat'). The matched sample is a plain 1:1 Mahalanobis-matched sample used as a sample restriction (allowed per PROTOCOL 5b). Table 7 (moderation) adds adoption x pre-sample characteristic interactions and is excluded; Appendix E 'nospot' columns for unique counts add a time-varying control and are excluded.
design_notes: User-week panel of Last.fm listeners (period = week, 66 weeks from May 29, 2014; analysis uses period > 4). Pipeline: importing_spotify_panel.do (external/spotify_panel.csv -> temp/spotify_panel.dta); matching.do (mahapick Mahalanobis matching of adopters to non-adopters on pre-sample consumption, unique 1:1 pairs -> temp/matched_unique.dta, with overlap_min/overlap_max = common observation window of the pair); preclean.do (merges, imputes pseudo-adoption week for matched controls, builds outcomes; adoption dummies are 1 only for adopters); tables.do (program make_regression_table: areg `m' $adoption_effects _Iperiod*, abs(user_id) vce(cluster user_id); get_data_mainsample keeps period>4, overlap_min<=period<=overlap_max, matched==1). $adoption_effects = adoption_shortterm (periods_since_adoption 0-1) adoption_mediumterm (2-24) adoption_longterm (25+), defined in define_adoption_dummies with cutoffs 1 and 24. Main text (main.rtf, tablenum starts at 2): Table 2 descriptives; Table 3 quantity (4 log playcount outcomes); Table 4 breadth (3 log unique counts, defined when plays_tot>0); Table 5 concentration (top-100/500 artist share of unique artists, Herfindahl artists/songs); Table 6 discovery (6 outcomes); Table 7 moderation (adoption_one + interactions, ineligible); Table 8 early-vs-late robustness (adopters only, weeks up to the median adoption week, late adopters as controls; long-run bin not estimable). Appendix D: descriptives, matching stats, placebo (pre-adoption only), heterogeneity summary. Appendix E: robustness (nomatch, unobs, lt, taylor, norun, nocabr, cabr, unlog, 1treat, nospot, share/xtgee, pshare, con2, con10, win12, top5).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 66 distinct adopt_period values (weeks 1-66) among 1,855 adopters in external/spotify_users.csv; the estimation sample (matched, period>4, adopt_day >= day 45 so censored early adopters are dropped) has fewer adopters; exact cohort count requires running matching.do.
published_estimates_note: No article text; coefficients not recorded. Tables report short-, medium- and long-run bins per outcome.

specs.treatment_definition: adoption==1 & periods_since_adoption in [0,1] / [2,24] / [25+]; zero for matched non-adopters; static version adoption_one = adoption==1 & periods_since_adoption>=0
specs.data_file: temp/preclean.dta built from external/spotify_panel.csv and external/spotify_users.csv

specs.sample_condition: main matched sample; user-weeks with plays_tot>0

specs.outcome: ss_shareu100_dyn (top-100 artists share of unique artists)
mnewu_artist (new artists played more than once / new artists)
specs.sample_condition: main matched sample; defined when new_artistu>0

specs.outcome: top8_1_artist (plays to top-1 new artist over next 8 weeks / plays to overall top-1 artist)
specs.sample_condition: main matched sample; outcome set to missing when the 8-week window straddles adoption (periods_since_adoption in [-8,-1]) or fewer than 8 weeks remain

specs.outcome: rob_luniq_artist = luniq_artist for adopters with period <= median adoption week
specs.treatment_var: adoption_shortterm adoption_mediumterm (adoption_longterm not estimable, dropped from table)
specs.sample_condition: adopters only (adoption==1) & period <= $adoption_split (median adopt_period among matched users); late adopters serve as not-yet-treated controls
specs.notes: Not-yet-treated comparison design; same areg specification.

specs.exclusion_reason: subgroup-by-treatment interactions (adoption_one x pre_herf_artists high, x age high, x perc_ads high, effect-coded)
specs.outcome: newu_artist newu_song mnewu_artist mnewu_song top8_1_artist top8_1_song

appendix_specs_note: Appendix E robustness tables (robust.rtf, Tables E2-E5) re-run the same areg specification under: nomatch (all users, unmatched), unobs (adopters only, late adopters as controls), lt (long-run cutoff 36 weeks), taylor (period<27), norun (period<51), nocabr/cabr (country splits), unlog (levels), 1treat (single adoption_one dummy = static TWFE), pshare/con2/con10/win12/top5 (alternative outcome definitions); 'nospot' adds the time-varying control lplays_not_on_spot for unique-count outcomes (ineligible) and 'share' uses xtgee fractional logit (ineligible). Appendix D4 placebo uses pre-adoption data only. These are appendix-only and not counted.
data_access: public (package ships the full user-week panel and user file collected from Last.fm; no restrictions stated)
data_files: external/spotify_users.csv (1.9 MB, user-level file with adopt_period and pre-sample covariates)
data_files_note: Analysis files (temp/spotify_panel.dta, temp/matched_unique.dta, temp/preclean.dta) must be rebuilt by running importing_spotify_panel.do, matching.do (requires mahapick, mahaselectunique) and preclean.do.
software_notes: Stata 14 (areg, xi, estout, mahapick, coefplot, rtfutil); make.bat / GNU make driver.
priority_note: Eligible with data and code; requires rebuilding the matched sample (Mahalanobis matching step).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Table numbers inferred from program main in tables.do (tablenum starts at 2 after the descriptive table). Adoption-week distribution computed from external/spotify_users.csv (66 distinct weeks). Static counterpart for re-estimation: adoption_one (post indicator), reported in Appendix E as the '1treat' robustness. Verify table numbering against the published article when text becomes available.
replication_status: exact (vs authors' areg re-run on the matched sample rebuilt with mahapick 1.2.1 / mahaselectunique 1.0.2, seed 12345); 19 event specs run Nov 1 (rep v4)
replication_blocked_resolved: mahapick/mahaselectunique installed by the user via ssc; matching rebuilt Nov 1 (448 of 507 adopters matched)
